notes.title: UI/Save Data fixes
notes.content:
This update should make some UI elements more clear, and it should fix issues with save data related to playing the demo. 

This will reset your save data - if you want to keep it, all you need to do is go to 
[b]Local Disk/Users/YourName/AppData/LocalLow/smallhex/sadball[/b]
and then rename all the old files to have the prefix [b]"Sadball_" [/b]

Nothing is really locked behind your save data anyways, so alternatively you can just skip this and use the level select to return to where you were.

[i]-fixed level select issues related to playing the demo
-fixed achievement issues related to playing the demo
-reworded level select
-added tooltips on data screen
-added start button reminder[/i]
